blocks.text:
## What to expect on the trip

The main part of the trip is an expedition to Mount Roraima. You’ll cross savannah and rivers, pass Indigenous settlements and climb to the base of the tepui. On the summit plateau, the trail leads through rock formations and canyons, past quartz crystals and plants that grow among the rocks. During the rainy season, small pools form between the rocks, and you may see black frogs found only on Roraima.

After the trek, the trip continues to Canaima. You’ll cross Canaima Lagoon in a curiara canoe and walk behind Sapo Falls. On the day trip to Angel Falls, you’ll travel upriver on the Carrao in a motorised curiara. From Ratonsito Island, you’ll hike to a viewpoint near the falls and return to the island for lunch.
